title: Degradation of the mechanical properties of NbMoTaW refractory high-entropy alloy in tension
process_method_2: vacuum arc melting + hot isostatic pressing
process_description: prepared by arc melting commercially pure Nb, Mo, Ta, and W slugs in a water-cooled Cu crucible under Ar atmosphere, remelted ten times for homogeneity, followed by hot isostatic pressing at 1850°C for 4 hours in Ar atmosphere with Hf pieces to reduce oxidation.
